shell_commands: timeout 300 npx vitest run src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | head -100

git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): cast AJV ErrorObject to access runtime instancePath property

AJV error objects have an instancePath property at runtime that is not
exposed in the TypeScript type definition. Cast through unknown to access it.
This fixes both the typecheck error and ensures validation error messages
include the field name as required by tests.
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main 2>&1
